deals.evidence: Davies acted for Rogers Communications Inc. in its acquisition of BCE Inc.’s 37.5% ownership stake in Maple Leaf Sports and Entertainment for C$4.7 billion.
deals.headline: Rogers completes C$4.7bn purchase of BCE's 37.5% of MLSE
deals.summary: Gave Rogers a 75% interest in MLSE, parent of the Raptors, Maple Leafs, Toronto FC and Argonauts.

deals.evidence: Rogers acquired the remaining 25% ownership stake in MLSE from Kilmer Sports Inc. for C$4.35 billion.
deals.headline: Rogers becomes 100% owner of MLSE
deals.summary: Rogers acquired the remaining 25% from Kilmer Sports for C$4.35bn; MLSE to sit in a new Rogers Sports unit. Sportico reports Rogers plans to sell a minority stake in its consolidated sports assets.

owners.evidence: increasing its ownership of MLSE to 100%
owners.name: Rogers Communications Inc. (via Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment)

ownership_summary: Owned by Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment (MLSE), which is 100% owned by Rogers Communications (TSX/NYSE: RCI) since 1 October 2026: Rogers bought BCE's 37.5% for C$4.7bn in July 2025 (to 75%) and Kilmer Sports' (Larry Tanenbaum) 25% for C$4.35bn. Rogers has said it plans to sell a minority stake in its combined sports assets.
